info.description: Identity verification API. Authenticate with x-api-key header.

request.description: Pre-create a business *without* a KYB session. All fields are optional, but you should always send `vendor_data` — without it the record cannot be linked to sessions or transactions. When provided, `vendor_data` must be unique among non-deleted businesses (exact match; conflicts return 400). Not idempotent.

response.name: Business created. Full business record returned (same shape as Get Business).

query.description: Page size. Defaults to 50 when omitted. There is no enforced maximum, but keep pages small for latency.
Zero-based offset of the first record to return. Prefer following the `next` URL from the previous page over computing this by hand.

request.description: List businesses Didit assembles from KYB sessions sharing the same `vendor_data` (free-form string, NOT a UUID), plus businesses created via the API. Paginated, ordered by `last_session_at` desc. This endpoint does not support filtering or search parameters — fetch pages and filter client-side.

response.name: Paginated list of businesses with status, session counts, and feature breakdown.

variable.description: (Required) Monitoring job UUID returned by the toggle endpoint.

request.description: Progress and per-outcome counters of a monitoring toggle job. Poll every couple of seconds while status is PENDING or PROCESSING.

response.name: The job.
response.body:
{
  "job_id": "<uuid>",
  "status": "PROCESSING",
  "is_enabled": "<boolean>",
  "total": "<integer>",
  "processed": "<integer>",
  "outcomes": {
    "enabled": "<integer>",
    "screened_and_enabled": "<integer>",
    "already_enabled": "<integer>",
    "disabled": "<integer>",
    "skipped_no_identity_data": "<integer>",
    "skipped_blocked": "<integer>",
    "skipped_sandbox": "<integer>",
    "failed_provider": "<integer>",
    "failed_insufficient_balance": "<integer>"
  },
  "error": "<string,null>",
  "estimate": {
    "users_total": "<integer>",
    "already_enabled": "<integer>",
    "with_existing_aml": "<integer>",
    "needing_screening": "<integer>",
    "skipped_no_identity_data": "<integer>",
    "skipped_blocked": "<integer>",
    "estimated_screening_cost_usd": "<number>",
    "estimated_annual_monitoring_cost_usd": "<number>",
    "balance_sufficient": "<boolean>"
  }
}

response.name: Unknown job for this application.

item.name: Toggle AML ongoing monitoring for businesses

request.description: Business-level equivalent of the user toggle: one monitored AML screening per business, with businesses lacking any AML screening screened first (company entity). Same estimate_only, inline fast-path and async job contract.

item.name: Toggle AML ongoing monitoring for business sessions

request.description: Session-level toggle for KYB verifications, addressed by session number. Sessions without an AML screening get one created and attached to the session itself. Same estimate_only, inline fast-path and async job contract as the user-level endpoints. Replaces the legacy synchronous behavior that skipped sessions without an AML screening.
